name: hf_uniocc_carla_mini
title: UniOcc, CARLA 10 Hz mini split: LiDAR sweeps, camera views and semantic occupancy grids
description: The smallest split of UniOcc (unified occupancy benchmark over nuScenes, Waymo, CARLA, OpenCOOD). Two CARLA scenes at 10 Hz; per time step a surround LiDAR sweep (.ply), four camera images, a bird's-eye view and an .npz with the 200x200x16 semantic occupancy grid, camera/LiDAR masks, voxel flow and the ego-to-world 4x4 transform. The other splits are folders of the same repo: pl.load('hf://tasl-lab/uniocc/NuScenes-via-Occ3D-2Hz-mini').

license.note: MIT on the Hub card (checked 2026-10-13). The nuScenes- and Waymo-derived splits of the same repo inherit the upstream terms of those datasets (non-commercial for nuScenes) - this manifest covers the CARLA split only.

citation: Wang Y., Huang X., Sun X., Yan M., Xing S., Tu Z., Li J. UniOcc: A Unified Benchmark for Occupancy Forecasting and Prediction in Autonomous Driving. arXiv:2503.24381, 2025.

lidar.description: Surround LiDAR sweep in the ego-vehicle frame

occupancy.description: Semantic occupancy grid 200x200x16 (L, W, H), class ids per the UniOcc repo; voxel size and grid origin are not stated on the card, so the grid is loaded with unit spacing (TO CONFIRM: 0.4 m voxels in the Occ3D convention)

layout.note: int64 class ids; 0 = free in the Occ3D convention [TO CONFIRM]

ego_to_world.description: 4x4 transform from the ego vehicle to the world frame (same .npz)
